subject: Private deployment environment gate review: information & checklist
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@vertexhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Vertex IT Ops <itops@vertexhealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: request for environment gate review and network artifacts

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with a private deployment (VPC) evaluation and would like Redwood to run an environment gate review before we schedule the on-site install. Attached is our current network diagram and a short inventory.

Can you confirm the preflight checklist items you need from us (account IDs, firewall rules, proxy details, KMS preferences, and any required ports)? We'd like to get the validation done this week if possible.

Attachments: vertexhealth-network-diagram.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Anna Lee
Head of Platform Engineering
Vertex Health

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: request for environment gate review and network artifacts

Hi Anna — thanks for the diagram, this is a good start. I've attached our Living Preflight Checklist (draft) and put inline the minimal items we'll need to validate the environment. If you can populate these and send back, we can run an automated validation and follow up with any gaps.

Minimal preflight items (please provide the values / screenshots where applicable):
- Cloud account IDs (primary & secondary if using cross-account IAM)
- VPC CIDR(s) and a representative subnet map (public/private/bastion)
- NAT/gateway details and expected outbound IP egress ranges
- Any customer-managed proxy or forward proxy details (hostname, port, auth)
- KMS key ARNs or HSM vendor details for key wrap (if using customer-managed keys)
- CIDR/IPs for Redwood egress endpoints (we will provide final list once you confirm region)
- Expected max simultaneous connections and typical request qps (for capacity recommendations)
- Firewall rules to permit inbound management connections (bastion/SSH or jumpbox) and monitoring agent egress

I'll schedule a 30-minute "gate walkthrough" with Marissa and Rishi to walk through the checklist and answer any networking questions. Proposed times: Wed 26 4pm PT or Thu 27 10am PT. Let me know which works.

Attachments: redwood-private-onboard-checklist-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Vertex Health gate prep — questions and call agenda

Team — looping you in with the Vertex materials. Quick points before the walkthrough:

1) NAT egress: their diagram shows an on-prem datacenter peering to the VPC; need to confirm whether egress will exit via their datacenter (customer egress) or via AWS NAT (cloud egress). If customer-managed, we'll need the static egress IPs and an SLA window for changes.

2) KMS: ask for KMS key policy and whether they want envelope encryption with a customer key. If HSM, capture vendor/support matrix.

3) Monitoring/agents: call out required ports 443 outbound for metrics and 1984 for our internal tracing collector (if customer blocks non-443, we need a port-mapping plan).

4) Service account roles: request a minimal IAM policy for the Redwood runtime to assume. If they insist on cross-account role, confirm trust policy.

I'll run the checklist live on the call. Agenda draft: 5 min intros, 15 min network diagram walkthrough, 5 min KMS/roles, 5 min next steps.

KMS: We plan to use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key in account 987654321012. I'll attach the key policy PDF after our security team signs off.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: request for environment gate review and network artifacts — preflight status and next steps

Hi Anna and team — quick summary from our gate walkthrough. We ran through the Redwood preflight checklist on today's call and have the items needed to start automated validation and an environment test run. High level:

- Account IDs: Received (987654321012) — mark PASS for account mapping.
- Egress: Customer-managed egress confirmed (203.0.113.10/11) — network team will validate NAT mapping for outbound token verification.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS plan acknowledged — awaiting key policy PDF for final KMS role mapping.
- Ports: monitoring/tracing ports flagged; IT Ops confirmed 443 outbound only for the pilot. We'll use an HTTPS tunnel and port 443 fallback for tracing to avoid opening non-standard ports.
- IAM: requested minimal role template shared; awaiting their cross-account trust statement.

Next steps:
1) Vertex to upload KMS key policy and confirm cross-account role trust (target EOD Tue 2026-06-01).
2) Redwood to run automated network validation against the provided egress IPs and return a short validation report and runbook.
3) Schedule a 2-hour pilot deployment window (tentative week of 2026-06-08).

I've attached our environment validation runbook for visibility. Let us know if anything is missing from this summary.

Attachments: env-validation-runbook.md (md)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager, Private Deployments
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
